description: Use after iso27001_gap_assessment when the user wants a plan towards ISO/IEC 27001 certification. Turns the same statuses into every gap with a recommended action, a priority, the Annex A control and a 30/60/90-day roadmap (organizational controls first). Requires ClevSec Pro.

answers.description: Control question id to status, e.g. {"o1": "implemented", "t3": "planned"}. Unanswered controls count as gaps.

name: iso27001_remediation_plan
title: ISO 27001 remediation plan (ClevSec Pro)
